summary: Monroe Capital Enhanced Corporate Lending Fund filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to provide a portfolio update as of June 30, 2026. The filing discloses fund statistics, including 100% first lien senior secured debt and floating rate investments, a debt-to-equity ratio of 1.1x, 39 portfolio companies, and portfolio company metrics such as weighted average EBITDA of $23.6 million and loan-to-value of 34.9%. No transaction, strategic action, or event of a special-situations nature is described. This is a routine operational disclosure, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors mentioned. The filing has no market-moving transactional content and is not an M&A event, tender, or capital action. Investors should view it as a standard periodic portfolio transparency update with no structural implications.
